name: 56636 · Deer River, MN
findings: ZIP 56636 (Deer River) has 10 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (60%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 56636 (Deer River) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
